title: Staking WETH - Open Lido App
meta_description: staking weth begins by unwrapping to ETH, then staking through Lido for stETH via the official Ethereum liquid staking app.
hero_h2: Turn wrapped ether into liquid staked ETH
hero_lead: staking weth starts by unwrapping to ETH, then using Lido's official app to mint stETH while keeping a liquid Ethereum position.
what_is: Lido is an Ethereum liquid staking protocol: WETH holders unwrap to native ETH, stake through the official app, and receive stETH as the liquid staking token. Ethereum.org describes WETH as an ERC-20 representation of ETH redeemable back to ETH.

how.d: Use Ethereum mainnet WETH and keep native ETH available for gas.
Convert WETH back to ETH through a trusted wallet or WETH contract route, since Lido staking uses ETH as the input.
Open stake.lido.fi, connect your wallet, enter the ETH amount, and review the transaction before signing.
After the stake transaction settles, stETH appears in your wallet and can be held, used in DeFi, or withdrawn through Lido's withdrawal flow.

points.p: The clean route is WETH to ETH to stETH; that keeps the action aligned with Ethereum's native staking asset instead of assuming a direct WETH deposit path.
Lido mints stETH for deposited ETH, so the position remains tokenized instead of requiring you to run validator infrastructure; read the Lido docs for protocol details.
Use stake.lido.fi for the app path, check wallet prompts carefully, and avoid lookalike domains before signing any transaction.

faq.q: Can I stake WETH directly with Lido?
faq.a: Lido's staking widget is built for ETH deposits. For WETH, unwrap to ETH first, then stake ETH in the official app to receive stETH.

faq.q: What does staking WETH mean in practice?
faq.a: It usually means converting wrapped ether back to native ETH and then using a liquid staking protocol, because Ethereum validators stake ETH, not ERC-20 WETH.

faq.q: Do I need ETH for gas when using WETH?
faq.a: Yes. Ethereum gas is paid in native ETH, so keep some ETH in the wallet before unwrapping, staking, or withdrawing.

faq.q: Where can I verify WETH before staking?
faq.a: Use the Wrapped Ether guide and confirm the connected app domain before signing any transaction.

faq.q: What risks matter before staking WETH?
faq.a: Risks include smart contract risk, validator penalties, changing rewards, liquidity-token market price risk, and user mistakes such as signing on a spoofed domain.

footer_note: Not the official Lido app; verify stake.lido.fi before connecting; educational only, not financial advice.
